text:
Ravi (AE): FYI - BioNexus needs a hosted POC window next Friday for integration testing. They asked for a scoped, short-lived key and a temporary quota increase to 350 qps for 90 minutes. Also need IP allowlist and key rotation docs.
Leah (Sales Eng): Do we have their org id and preferred time window? Any special token sizes?
Ravi (AE): Org: org_bionexus_77. Window request: 2026-06-05 09:30-11:00 PDT. Average response size ~40 tokens, spikey during parallel sessions.
Ilya (Platform Eng): 350 qps is doable as a short exception. We'll need exact start/end epoch, CIDR ranges, and a rollback plan. Recommend 10m ramp: 0 -> 75 -> 150 -> 250 -> 350. Also note we enforce p95 latency fallback to 120ms.
Ravi (AE): CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and single IP 198.51.100.23/32. Customer wants the scoped key to expire automatically at window end and be revocable.
Marta (SRE): I can attach the fallback throttle and a synthetic traffic monitor. I'll need the request ticket and approver + spend cap. If errors exceed 1% for 5m we cut to 100 qps automatically.
Leah (Sales Eng): Billing check - the customer expects the POC to be covered by a $750 prepaid cap for this window. Confirmed?
Ravi (AE): Yes, customer ok with $750 hard cap and retains right to cancel mid-test.
Ilya (Platform Eng): I'll create the scoped role scoped:poс_poc (note special char removed) and generate the key. Sharing method will be secure DM to the AE. Sample usage:
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_SCOPED_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}]}'
```
Ilya (Platform Eng): Client guidance: honor Retry-After headers, use exponential backoff with jitter, and include org id in X-Org header to help routing.
quota-bot: Received quota exception request Q-8439 for org_bionexus_77.
quota-bot: Approved +290 qps (total 350 qps) for scoped key scoped:poс_poc. Window 1916004200 -> 1916009600. Request Q-8439. Approver: infra-ops.
Marta (SRE): Exception applied; dashboards spun up. I'll monitor p95, error rate, and GPU queue depth. I'll post any alerts here.
Ravi (AE): Please DM the key to me once created. Also send rotation steps the customer can follow (we prefer they call the rotate endpoint mid-window if they want to swap).
Ilya (Platform Eng): Key created. DM sent to Ravi. Rotation endpoint example:
```
POST /v1/keys/rotate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>
Body: {"key_id":"<POC_KEY_ID>","rotate_to":"ephemeral"}
```
Leah (Sales Eng): Updating the internal POC checklist with the cap and abort instructions. Noting the fallback thresholds.
Marta (SRE): Monitoring live. If sustained p95 >120ms for 2m or errors >1% for 5m I'll trigger fallback and notify.
Ravi (AE): Got it, I'll confirm with the customer and share their readiness checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
